response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(c.gender, 'MISSING') as gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) as invoiced_order_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.gender, 'MISSING')), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_order_count) as overall_avg FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(g.invoiced_order_count) as average_figure, AVG(g.invoiced_order_count - a.overall_avg) as average_excess FROM gender_counts g CROSS JOIN avg_calc a WHERE g.invoiced_order_count > a.overall_avg
